title: Synthetic smoke catalog
summary: block_sweep's synthetic catalog for smoke tests: 600 frames over 40 cases, drawn by code, no patient.
does: A small catalog drawn by tools/block_sweep.py with no real image in it, for checking that every block combination runs before any grid time is spent: 600 frames over 40 cases, 100 test frames and 200 unlabelled, seed 1. The sweep flow's synthetic plan (grid/sweeps/synthetic.json) trains on it. Nothing measured on it is a result.

outputs.what: Synthetic grey frames with level boxes, split by person as real ones are.
